name: Ephemeris and Technical Specifications
description: Foundational technical specifications for ephemeris data, timezone handling, and astrological calculation methods
authority: Swiss Ephemeris / NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory

ephemeris_definition.description: Ephemeris tables containing precise positions of celestial bodies at specific dates/times

ecliptic_longitude.precision: Degrees, minutes, seconds (0.01° = ~1 km at Earth's distance)

right_ascension.definition: Celestial longitude measured from vernal equinox

common_sources: Rectification technique (time calculated from known events)

timezone_handling.critical_for: Converting local birth time to UTC/GMT

dst_considerations.description: DST shifts create 1-hour gaps in local time
dst_considerations.verification: Confirm DST status for birth date and location

latitude.critical_for: House system calculations, especially high-latitude births

high_latitude_challenges.effect: Placidus house system breaks down (some houses become extremely large or non-existent)

aspects.orb_application: ±X degrees depending on aspect type and planets involved

high_latitude_birth.effect: Placidus house system may degrade or fail
high_latitude_birth.solution: Use Whole Sign or Equal House; flag reliability as degraded

verification_procedures.determinism_check: Run calculation 3× with identical inputs; results must be identical to ±0.001°
verification_procedures.cross_check: Verify results against independent ephemeris sources
verification_procedures.tolerance_compliance: Check that all calculations fall within published tolerances

retrograde_calculation.definition: Planet appears to move backward when Earth passes it in orbit
retrograde_calculation.calculation: Compare planet position on sequential dates; when longitude decreases, planet is retrograde
retrograde_calculation.significance: Astrological interpretation focuses on internal/karmic reworking
retrograde_calculation.accuracy: Can be calculated to ±0.1° with ephemeris data

authority_source: Swiss Ephemeris / NASA JPL / SOLEX / Traditional Astrological Methods
